units.source_text: 次日，预定回京都去，为了惜别，这一天早上起身稍迟。

en.t: The next day, as he was scheduled to return to Kyoto and wanted to savor the farewell, he rose a little late that morning.

units.source_text: 他准备从这里直接返京。

en.t: He planned to go straight back to the capital from there.

units.source_text: 但京中来了许多达官贵人，聚集在桂院。

en.t: But many high-ranking nobles had come from the capital and gathered at the Katsura residence.

units.source_text: 又有许多殿上人到这邸内来迎接他。

en.t: Many courtiers also came into the mansion to receive him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一面整理行装，一面懊恼地说：“真不好意思！

en.t: Prince Genji, while arranging his traveling things, said in distress, "How embarrassing!

units.source_text: 这里不容易找到，他们怎么会来的？”

en.t: This place is not easy to find, so how did they manage to come here?"

units.source_text: 外面人声嘈杂，他就不得不走出去。

en.t: The voices outside were noisy, so he had no choice but to go out.

units.source_text: 临别无限伤心，脸上没精打采，走到明石姬房间门口，停下步来，正好乳母抱着小女公子出来了。

en.t: Deeply saddened by the parting and looking dejected, he walked to the doorway of Lady Akashi's room and stopped, just as the nurse came out carrying the little princess.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看见这孩子非常可爱，伸手摸摸她的头发，说道：“我不看见她，心中便难过，实在爱得太过分了。

en.t: Prince Genji saw how adorable the child was, reached out to stroke her hair, and said, "When I do not see her, my heart aches; I truly love her too much.

units.source_text: 这便如何是好呢？

en.t: What am I to do about this?

units.source_text: 这地方真是‘君家何太远’了。”

en.t: This place is truly one where 'your home is far too distant.'"

units.source_text: 乳母答道：“从前住在乡下，想念得好痛苦！

en.t: The nurse replied, "When we lived in the countryside before, longing for you was terribly painful.

units.source_text: 如今到了京中，倘再不得照顾，那真是比从前更加痛苦了！”

en.t: Now that we have come to the capital, if we still cannot receive your care, it will truly be even more painful than before!"

units.source_text: 小女公子伸出两手，扑向站着的父亲，要他抱。

en.t: The little princess stretched out both hands toward her standing father, reaching for him to hold her.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便坐下来抱了她，说道：“怪哉，我一生忧患，竟无尽头！

en.t: Prince Genji sat down and held her, saying, "How strange; the sorrows of my life seem to have no end.

units.source_text: 一刻不见这孩子便觉痛苦。

en.t: Even a moment without seeing this child feels painful to me.

units.source_text: 夫人在哪里？

en.t: Where is the lady?

units.source_text: 何不与小女公子一同出来送别？

en.t: Why does she not come out with the little princess to see me off?

units.source_text: 再见一面，亦可聊以慰情啊。”

en.t: If I could see her once more, it would at least comfort my heart a little."

units.source_text: 乳母笑着，进去告知了明石姬。

en.t: The nurse smiled and went inside to tell Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 明石姬此时芳心缭乱，倒在床上，一时起不得身。

en.t: At that moment Lady Akashi's heart was in turmoil, and she lay on the bed, unable to rise for a while.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得未免太高贵了。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that this was rather too dignified.

units.source_text: 众侍女都劝她快快出去，不应该叫公子久候，她才勉强起身，膝行而前，把半身隐在帷屏后面，姿态非常优美高雅。

en.t: All the waiting women urged her to go out quickly, saying she should not keep the prince waiting long; only then did she reluctantly rise, move forward on her knees, and hide half her body behind the curtain screen, her bearing exquisitely graceful and refined.

units.source_text: 如此娇艳模样，即便说她是个皇女，也无不称之处。

en.t: With such radiant beauty, even if one called her an imperial princess, there would be nothing unfitting about it.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便把帷屏的垂布撩起，与她细说离情。

en.t: Prince Genji then lifted the hanging cloth of the screen and spoke with her in detail of the sorrow of parting.
